question: Should fs-safe 0.5 intentionally stop executing configured Python helper paths and require users who select require mode to install a matching native platform package?
rationale: The PR describes this as an intentional compatibility change, but the supplied approval text is authored by the contributor and does not establish an independent maintainer decision.

options.title: Approve native-only migration
